title: (Playback) Error: Messages do not match!
description:
I recorded a simple test that just loads the application waits a few seconds, then closes the browser. I keep getting a failure at line 77 of playback. I've copied the specific error below, with the last line in the output as well. It seems like that's the line that it fails.

```
a["0#0|m|{\\"config\\":{\\"workerId\\":\\"5ea5af74\\",\\"sessionId\\":\\"${SESSION}\\",\\"user\\":null}}"]

0 succeeded, 2 failed
2 incidences of:
Error: Messages do not match!

Expected:
a["0#0|m|{\\"config\...

Actual:
a["0#0|m|{\\"config\...
    at ShinyWSInitReceiveEvent.execute (/home/o771465/proxyrec/lib/shiny-events.js:510:13)
    at <anonymous>
    at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:188:7)
```

```
74	2017-12-12T23:13:39.547Z	2	WS_RECV	0
75	2017-12-12T23:13:39.557Z	1	WS_SEND	9
76	2017-12-12T23:13:39.560Z	0	WS_SEND	2
77	2017-12-12T23:13:39.617Z	56	WS_RECV_INIT	0
# Failure
# Job finished in 18363ms
```

And here is the snippet from the actual playback file
```
{"type":"WS_RECV_INIT","created":"2017-12-12T22:23:12.604Z","message":"a[\"0#0|m|{\\\\\"config\\\\\":{\\\\\"workerId\\\\\":\\\\\"5ea5af74\\\\\",\\\\\"sessionId\\\\\":\\\\\"${SESSION}\\\\\",\\\\\"user\\\\\":null}}\"]"}
```

The next line in that playback file is:
```
{"type":"WS_RECV","created":"2017-12-12T22:23:13.916Z","message":"a[\"2#0|m|{\\\\\"custom\\\\\":{\\\\\"shinyjs-onevent\\\\\":{\\\\\"event\\\\\":\\\\\"click\\\\\",\\\\\"id\\\\\":\\\\\"NCAL\\\\\",\\\\\"shinyInputId\\\\\":\\\\\"shinyjs-NCAL-841759203-input-click\\\\\",\\\\\"add\\\\\":false}}}\"]"}
```

That WS_RECV line above has to do with an onClick event using ShinyJS. Could this be the culprit?
I should also mention that the server in question is an RSConnect box behind a firewall and this test is running through a VPN. Not sure if it makes a difference, but I thought I'd mention it.

title: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3838
description:
Hello,

We installed proxyrec in a mac desktop and run successfully the first step recording the load test:
 
proxyrec record -p 8602 -t 'http://discovery.nci.nih.gov:9090' > cdb-recording.txt
 
and we run our app “cellminercdb_test” using http://localhost:8602/cellminercdb_test and we recorded the requests in file cdb-recording.txt
 
Now performing the load test we got an error when running the proxyrec playback:
proxyrec playback cdb-recording.txt –t 'http://discovery.nci.nih.gov:9090' –c 20 –d '5min' -o 'loadtests'
 
Here is the message:
 
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
 
0 succeeded, 7616 failed
7616 incidences of:
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3838
    at Object.exports._errnoException (util.js:1026:11)
    at exports._exceptionWithHostPort (util.js:1049:20)
    at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (net.js:1136:14)
---------------------------------------------
    at Socket.Readable.on (_stream_readable.js:759:35)
    at tickOnSocket (_http_client.js:652:10)
    at onSocketNT (_http_client.js:682:5)
    at _combinedTickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:102:11)
    at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:161:9)
---------------------------------------------
    at ClientRequest.onSocket (_http_client.js:670:11)
    at _http_agent.js:190:11
    at oncreate (_http_agent.js:236:5)
    at Agent.createSocket (_http_agent.js:223:5)
    at Agent.addRequest (_http_agent.js:183:10)
    at new ClientRequest (_http_client.js:271:16)
    at Object.request (http.js:39:10)
    at ShinyEvent.execute.Promise (/snapshot/proxyrec/lib/shiny-events.js:0)

Could you help us to solve this issue? Using the latest proxyrec from github gave the same error. Do we need to have port 3838 for shiny server?
 
Thanks,
 
Fathi
